title: Chapter 103
text:
The monster raised its thick arm and smashed it down like it was swatting a fly. The huge force caused the air pressure to suffocate Han Xiao, and the stench assaulted his nostrils.

Han Xiao's reaction was lightning fast. He slid like a loach and dodged the attack by a hair's breadth. The strong wind blew his hair into a mess. The monster's palm hit the ground with a loud bang. A hole was formed in the ground, and a circle of dust was raised. Han Xiao quickly held his breath and squinted to prevent the dust from flying in.

He pulled out the Berserk Eagle and fired. The bullet hit the monster's rotten flesh, and the stench of pus splashed out.

You have dealt 57 damage to Test Subject 002!

You have entered combat mode. Based on your level, you have received the following information.

— —

Test Subject 002

Level: 42

Class: [Low Level Biological Aberration] (END to HP conversion ratio: 1: 100)

Attributes: 65 STR, 20 DEX, 60 END (90), 1 INT, MYS? Charm? Luck?

Energy: 0

Energy Rank:?

Health Points: 1854/7800 (Continuous decay)

Status: Severe decay, -25 DEF, -30 END, Severe deterioration of all senses

Talent: [Low Level Aberration] (+ 5 STR, + 10 END)

Intermediate Strengthened Life (Additional increase in HP conversion ratio: 1: 30)

？？ ??? …

Skills: [Silent Walk] LV12, [Smash] LV8, [Charge] LV5,?? ??? …

— —

The level cap of all professions was not 10. Some high-end professions and special professions had a higher level cap. [Biological Aberration] was a special type of profession.

Han Xiao fired both guns consecutively. The large caliber penetrating bullets bombarded Test Subject 002's body, creating bullet holes. The sound of gunfire could be heard from afar.

"After making such a big commotion, I have to end this quickly." Han Xiaoxin's heart sank. Fortunately, Test Subject 002's condition was very bad. If it was full health, he would have turned around and run immediately.

Test Subject 002 did not seem to feel any pain. It lowered its head and rushed over in large strides. It gave Han Xiao the feeling of a steam locomotive crashing into him! This caused his heart to involuntarily shrink!

Han Xiao sheathed his gun and pulled out his katana. The retractable katana slashed viciously at the monster's head. With a clang, the katana penetrated the monster's skull, causing pus to splatter everywhere. He had also taken a lot of damage from Test Subject 002's collision. He only had time to put his hands in front of him to block the attack. He felt like he was facing a charging rhinoceros head-on. He couldn't stabilize his body and stumbled backward, knocking over two test benches. His arms were in great pain, and his chest was filled with a stifling sensation.

The Contusion status appeared on the interface.

The katana was embedded in Test Subject 002's skull, and yellowish-white pus continuously flowed out from the wound. The monster opened its bloody mouth wide as if it was roaring, but its decayed vocal cords could only produce hoarse cries. Both of its fists carried a strong gust of wind and dust with them. However, Han Xiao could clearly see the trajectory of the attack. His 48 points of Dexterity were more than double the monster's. The collision just now was clearly the monster's skill, and it could not be used continuously. Han Xiao also took the opportunity to test whether the enemy had any vital points. The conclusion was very clear. This monster really did not have a brain. Even if its head was chopped off, it could still move.

Han Xiao brushed his fists and dodged. He quickly went behind Test Subject 002. He rubbed his palms together and activated the thermo-electric incisor gloves. He pressed them on the back of Test Subject 002's heart. The surface of the gloves lit up with a dazzling blue and white light. It was extremely dazzling in the dark. The contact area exploded with an extremely high temperature, quickly burning through the rotting flesh of the monster. A burnt smell quickly filled the air.

His palms sank into a viscous organ. He violently stirred, and white smoke rose from the wound. Test Subject 002 kept waving its arms, but Han Xiao narrowly avoided all of them.

The thermo-electric incisor gloves' continuous damage was extremely high. In just ten seconds, it had dealt no less than 800 damage. It almost burned through Test Subject 002's body. Suddenly, the gloves flickered a few times, and the light dimmed. They had run out of energy. The high-energy battery could only support the operation of the gloves for a few minutes. Su Li had been fighting with these gloves for a long time, and there was only a trace of energy left.

Han Xiao quickly retreated and used his Dexterity to fight. This big guy was like a low-level beast with no intelligence at all. Although its attributes were high, Han Xiao's Dexterity made it easy for him to deal with it. Only Tackle posed a threat.

With the help of the terrain and obstacles, Han Xiao finally killed Test Subject 002 one shot after another.

The monster swayed around like a drunk and fell down with a loud bang. Pus slowly flowed out from the muzzles all over its body.

You have killed Test Subject 002 (LV42). You have received 32000 EXP.

As you have killed a target 10 levels above you, you have received an additional 280% EXP. Total EXP: 89600. Your damage output: 23.7%.

You have received an additional 21235 (23.7%) EXP.

The rustling sound became louder and louder, as if it was right next to his ears. There were many densely packed appendages coming out from the gaps of the hollowed-out metal plates under his feet.

Han Xiao's expression suddenly changed. He ran back the way he came.

There was a loud sound of metal colliding with metal in the distance, accompanied by a beast-like roar. He could vaguely see something moving toward him.

All signs indicated that he had triggered some sort of event by killing this monster.

The one that Han Xiao had killed was test subject 002, and the diary stated that the last test subject was 008. There were a few more monsters like 002, and they might even be stronger. They were wandering around some corner of the base! Now that he had gotten what he wanted, if he didn't run now, was he going to stay for the new year?

Surrounded by all kinds of noises, Han Xiao ran as fast as he could. Fortunately, he was not in any danger. He quickly climbed up the cliff and returned to the surface.

The sun shone on his body, and his tense nerves gradually relaxed. The atmosphere in the abandoned base was too gloomy. The sense of danger everywhere made him feel as if he was walking on a tightrope. Only now did he feel better.

In his arms were the three vials of Felonia serum. Han Xiao was not sure how valuable they were, but now was not the time to check his loot. It would not take long for the various forces in Somar to discover the abnormality in this place.

With that in mind, Han Xiao immediately drove away.

An hour after he left, many vehicles arrived at the entrance of Felonia and surrounded the entrance of the cave. The leaders of the various forces hurriedly informed their financial backers, while the armed forces stared at each other covetously.

The financial backers had given the order to explore the place first.

Therefore, the armed forces temporarily stopped fighting and sent out small teams into the base. The dark and gloomy atmosphere was slightly diluted.

"There are desert worms in the lower level."

"Ask the people above to send down the flamethrowers."

Someone was holding a cone-shaped flamethrower and burning the dead insects through the hollow metal board, making ear-piercing screeching noises. The smell of roasted insect meat mixed with the rotten smell of the base was nauseating.

The desert worms were about forty to eighty centimeters long. They looked like centipedes with shells on their backs. There were tentacles and red compound eyes on their heads. Their chelicerae were strong enough to break a human's bones and were used for feeding.

There were thousands of desert worms in the abandoned base, and they soon started to counterattack. The worms climbed to the upper level and swept in from both ends of the tunnel. The mercenaries temporarily formed an alliance and formed a defensive base. They used flamethrowers and bullets to repel the worms.

When the situation was stabilized, the worms suddenly dispersed. A few rotting giant bodies rushed out. They walked silently and knocked away a few mercenaries while braving the flames and bullets. They created a gap in the mercenaries' formation.

The mercenaries were shocked.

"What the hell is this? It's disgusting! "

"Quickly fill in the gaps!"

"F * ck, the worms are coming in."

"Kill the monsters first … Wait, there are three more monsters!"

"Requesting firepower support. I repeat, requesting firepower support!"

The sound of gunfire lasted for a long time before it turned into a deathly silence.

The ground was littered with burnt worm corpses and bullet casings. The few test subjects were riddled with holes. The mercenaries had suffered heavy losses, but at least the battle was over.

Gaton kicked a test subject's corpse and thought to himself, 'This seems to be a biochemical test subject.'

After tidying up the battlefield, the mercenaries began to explore the base from top to bottom. They blasted open the sealed rooms, but they didn't find much. Most of the things inside were rusty experimental equipment. There were, however, some paper records of the base that had been plundered.

The most valuable things were the traces of the dried blood serum and the test subjects' corpses. The people behind these mercenaries needed these things. They might be able to find a specialized biochemical laboratory to replicate the effects of the serum. However, from the looks of the test subjects' deformities, the serum was still incomplete.

When the mercenaries arrived at the large laboratory where Han Xiao had been, they were stunned. There was a new test subject, 002, lying there with fresh wounds.

"Someone beat us to it!"
